facts.fact: Universal Ads has no markups, no upfront commitment, and no contracts.
facts.quote: Universal Ads has no markups, no upfront commitment, and no contracts.

facts.fact: Advertisers can build, launch, optimize, and measure Universal Ads campaigns without buying through a partner, using Universal Ads Manager, MCP integrations, the Universal Ads API, or partner platforms.
facts.quote: Do advertisers have to buy through a partner? No. Advertisers can build, launch, optimize, and measure campaigns through Universal Ads Manager, MCP integrations, the Universal Ads API, or partner platforms

facts.fact: Universal Ads launched a Campaign Management category within its Business Partners Program, with launch partners Adlyse, Atrium, Concord, Kochava, Koddi, Olyzon, Orbee, Scale Up, SearchKings, Stellair AI, Topsort, and WorkMagic, with additional partners to come.
facts.quote: Campaign Management launch partners include Adlyse, Atrium, Concord, Kochava, Koddi, Olyzon, Orbee, Scale Up, SearchKings, Stellair AI, Topsort, and WorkMagic with additional partners to come.

facts.fact: Universal Ads describes itself as Comcast Advertising's self-service platform, where brands of any size create, buy, and measure TV and premium video ads directly from top publishers.
facts.quote: Universal Ads is Comcast Advertising's self-service platform. Brands of any size use it to create, buy, and measure TV and premium video ads directly from top publishers.

facts.fact: Universal Ads Campaign Management partners embed TV activation into their own platforms so advertisers can add TV alongside search, social, and other digital channels without switching tools.
facts.quote: Partners embed TV activation into their own platforms, so advertisers can add TV alongside search, social, and other digital channels without switching tools.

facts.fact: Advertisers choose a goal, audience, and spend when building a Universal Ads campaign and can measure results from awareness to conversions.
facts.quote: Advertisers choose a goal, audience, and spend, and measure results from awareness to conversions.
